edbDesc: Seen in some magnetic materials, saturation is the state reached when an increase in applied external magnetising field cannot increase the magnetisation of the material further, so the total magnetic field levels off. It is a characteristic particularly of ferromagnetic materials, such as iron, nickel, cobalt and their alloys.
title: Magnetic Saturation
pickWhy: Borderline: Saturation is the top end of the same magnetisation (B-H) curve as hysteresis, found in the same studies; judgment call between its own card (fluxgates, magnetic amplifiers) and merging, picked merge with fluxgates listed on the hysteresis card.
